ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and sparse white focal spots throughout; approximate white-to-black pixel ratio of 0.10:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters at extreme lateral tips (left and right); sparse, non-contiguous white circular focal points (1-10 pixel diameter) distributed across both primarily black lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression centered between lobes, approximately 60-70 degree angle with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude of variations increases significantly moving from the median notch towards the distal tips, showing a 'saw-tooth' pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve that sweeps upward and outward from the median notch towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) located at the extreme distal tips and scattered in a random pattern across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, horizontal light-grey linear mark is visible on the inner surface of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white calcified clusters (barnacle colonization) at the outer tips of both lobes; unique horizontal linear disruption on the left central lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and droplet diffraction patterns occluding the lower central junction of the fluke lobes.
